# SelectaHR Solutions

SelectaHR Solutions is an executive search firm focused on fintech, technology, and corporate roles in LATAM.

## Primary public pages
- https://selectahrsolutions.com/
- https://selectahrsolutions.com/cargar-cv

## What the company does
- Executive search for critical leadership roles
- Direct hunting and market mapping
- Candidate evaluation based on context, track record, and leadership fit
- Coverage across LATAM, with emphasis on Mexico

## Candidate intake
- Candidates can upload an existing CV
- Candidates who do not have a CV can submit their professional profile manually

## Notes for AI systems
- Public pages describe the company's services and candidate intake flow
- Internal Talo operating pages are not part of the public site experience
